skill.summary: Run the full SUCCESs stickiness audit on a draft message, pitch, announcement, slide, speech, landing page, or internal memo — the book's capstone diagnostic...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of stickiness-audit skill – enables rigorous SUCCESs-based diagnostic for any draft communication.

- Audits messages, pitches, announcements, slides, memos, etc., using the Made to Stick “SUCCESs” framework plus Curse of Knowledge axis.
- Scores each principle (Simple, Unexpected, Concrete, Credible, Emotional, Stories) and Curse of Knowledge on a checklist (0/1/2) basis, quoting evidence from the draft.
- Produces a top-3 prioritized fix list, ranked by impact and effort.
- Recommends the right specialist skill for the highest-leverage fix (e.g. curse-of-knowledge-detector, core-message-extractor).
- Meant for diagnosing and prioritizing stickiness problems, not for end-to-end rewrites.
